data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for Google OAuth sign‑in using Firebase UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made UI components that handle the Google sign‑in flow integrated with Firebase Authentication. It abstracts the google_sign_in 7 API and updates Firebase dependencies automatically.
use_when: You need a quick, out‑of‑the‑box Google sign‑in UI for a Firebase‑backed app
You want consistent look‑and‑feel with other Firebase UI widgets
avoid_when: You require a fully custom sign‑in UI
You need to support Google sign‑in on platforms not listed (e.g., desktop without web fallback)
strengths: Keeps dependencies aligned with latest FlutterFire releases
Works across Android, iOS, Web, macOS
weaknesses: Breaks on major version upgrades (see 3.0.0 notes)
data.setup_notes: Add google_sign_in 7 and firebase_auth to pubspec, configure Google OAuth client IDs for each platform, and ensure Firebase initialization (firebase_core) is done before use

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides lower‑level Google sign‑in without Firebase UI, allowing full UI customization

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core Firebase authentication API; you can implement Google sign‑in manually for more control
